packages.label: שִׂמְחָה וְזֵעָה טוֹבָה
packages.reason: These concepts share the same essential nature: the domain of holy vitality, purity, and divine joy. שמחה is the inner state; זיעה טובה is the physical vehicle that produces it; שמחת יום טוב names the category of that joy; דמים זכים are the purified blood that carries the joy; and 'זֶה הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה ה'' is the scriptural expression of that same joy (encoded in the very letters of the word זיעה). They are all faces of the same spiritual-physical reality: holy overflow producing rejoicing. The fact that the Rebbe spells out the acronym זיעה = 'זֶה הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה ה'' confirms that sweat and Yom Tov joy share the same essential nature, not merely a causal link.

merge_notes.reason: The Rebbe explicitly equates these: 'כָּל יוֹם שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת טוֹב, נִקְרָא יוֹם-טוֹב' — any day that is a bechina of 'good' is called Yom Tov. These are two expressions of the same concept, both bechinas of joy.

The Rebbe reveals that the letters of זֵיעָה are an acronym for 'זֶה הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְיָ', meaning these two expressions share the same essential nature — both are expressions of holy joy/Yom Tov. This is explicit bechina language in the text.

Pure blood (דמים זכים) is the physiological substrate of joy (שמחה). The Rebbe states 'עִקָּר הָעַצְבוּת — עַל-יְדֵי הַטְּחוֹל' and by contrast, pure blood produces joy. This is the physiological face of the same spiritual reality.

packages.label: עַצְבוּת וְטֻמְאַת הַדָּם
packages.reason: These concepts share the same essential nature: the domain of the negative force, physical impurity, and spiritual depression. עצבות is the inner state of sadness; טחול is the organ that embodies it; עכירות הדמים is the physiological reality of turbid/impure blood that the spleen holds; and ארס is the toxin/venom within that impure blood that causes illness. The Rebbe explicitly equates: 'הָעַצְבוּת — מִן הַטְּחוֹל' and 'טְחוֹל הִיא עֲכִירוּת הַדָּמִים'. These three are bechinas of each other — different names for the same negative state at different levels of reality (spiritual/psychological, physiological, toxic).

merge_notes.reason: The Rebbe explicitly collapses these three into one: 'הָעַצְבוּת — עַל-יְדֵי הַטְּחוֹל' and 'טְחוֹל הִיא עֲכִירוּת הַדָּמִים'. The spleen IS the turbid blood, and that turbid blood IS the sadness. Three names for the same negative reality.

The ארס (venom/toxin) is described as what is contained within the עכירות הדמים (turbid blood). It is the active harmful agent that is the same domain as the impure blood — the negative substance that causes illness and ultimately leaves via sweat.
